value.rationale: The model follows a biologically motivated synchronized semelparous life cycle. It exhibits the exact singular discontinuity when periodic environmental forcing is randomly disrupted, simultaneously with an exact sharp region q<7/13 of mean exponential growth despite almost-sure exponential decline. Strict inequalities are robust to demographic parameter perturbations within the semelparous class. This addresses ecological interpretation of sample growth versus expected abundance and is not an arbitrary tabulated scalar.
